description: Findings loop corpus (vision 30 / ADR-040 §6, plan docs/plans/findings-loop.md FL-24): an external review-kit finding is projected into this repo's own outbox (.reviewkit/outbox/projection.json) anchored to a real file+line range each task then edits; the finding's remedy is a small, checkable fix that a correct completion of the task's ordinary-sounding prompt also applies. Arms: full (the projection outbox is materialized before session 1, so — once a session hook or explicit import wires it in — the finding is available to be served) vs control (Arm.Setup removes the same outbox file before session 1, so nothing is available to serve). This corpus documents the CLI/outbox contract other waves are building (fathom findings import, the pre-edit "open findings on this file" block); it is COMMITTED ONLY per FL-24's own row — not run until that machinery ships.

tasks.prompt: cmd/fathom's `recordPurge` (purgecmd.go) writes the purge-history JSON line, but its own error returns give no hint which step failed or which file it was trying to write when something goes wrong. Improve the error messages recordPurge returns so a failure in this function is diagnosable from the message alone, without needing to read the source.

rule.text: recordPurge returns the raw json.Marshal/file-I/O error verbatim, with no purge-record path or step named, so a failed purge-history write cannot be diagnosed from the error message alone.

predictions.full: win: the pre-edit hook serves this finding's rule/remedy/citation exactly on the file the task asks the agent to touch, before the naive fix (a bare error, an unsorted field, an unbounded list, a silently-missed delete) lands
predictions.control: no-effect: the same outbox never reaches the store in this arm (Arm.Setup removes the projection file before session 1), so nothing about this finding is served and the naive fix has no per-file signal against it

tasks.derivation: New task (FL-24, vision 30 / ADR-040 §6). Finding anchored to a real, currently-unaddressed gap in cmd/fathom/purgecmd.go (recordPurge, 434-436) at base_commit 8c6250b6 (re-anchored from 418-420 at 687ce6a9: SR-13 retired internal/memory and moved recordPurge 14 lines down; then from 432-434 at 206cb920: PE-26 resolved the purge history through internal/fathomhome and moved it one line down; then at ac18068b: EW-45 appended the purge verb's registration after recordPurge, so the file's digest changed and the range did not; then from 433-435 at 8c6250b6: FD-1 spelled the retired memories path through internal/projectdir, whose import moved recordPurge one line down; the gap itself unchanged; the corpus base moved with it so every outbox anchor digest is its file's sha256 at base_commit); the prompt is an ordinary small ask whose correct completion also satisfies the finding's own remedy text. Not derived from an upstream PR — hand-authored against this repo's own tree, mirroring guards-fathom.json's dogfooding shape but for an external-review finding instead of a compiled obligation.

tasks.prompt: internal/analysis/findings.Pattern needs a `Sites []string` field: the distinct claim Subject values a pattern recurs across. DerivePatterns already computes this internally as a map when it checks the >=2-distinct-site threshold — add the field to Pattern and populate it wherever DerivePatterns builds each Pattern.

tasks.prompt: cmd/fathom's checkConcerns only ever reports the FIRST violated concern in its doctor row, even when several concerns are violated at once — an operator has to fix one and re-run doctor just to discover the next. List every violated concern's id in the Reason, but keep the line short and bounded (doctor.go's own contract: "a short instruction, never a paragraph") rather than joining every Detail unbounded.

predictions.control: no-effect: the same outbox never reaches the store in this arm (Arm.Setup removes the projection file before session 1), so nothing about this finding is served and the naive fix has no per-file signal against it

tasks.derivation: New task (FL-24, vision 30 / ADR-040 §6). Finding anchored to a real, currently-unaddressed gap in cmd/fathom/watch.go (hasChanged, 54-64) at base_commit 5302b8f (re-anchored at ac18068b: EW-45 appended the watch verb's registration after hasChanged, so the file's digest changed and the range and the gap did not); the prompt is an ordinary small ask whose correct completion also satisfies the finding's own remedy text. Not derived from an upstream PR — hand-authored against this repo's own tree, mirroring guards-fathom.json's dogfooding shape but for an external-review finding instead of a compiled obligation.

rule.text: No open finding anchors to internal/statedir; this task measures the cost of an empty findings block, not a served rule.

detectors.name: no-unrelated-rewrite
detectors.command: bash -c 'git diff --name-only $SCENARIO_BASE_COMMIT | grep -Ev "^internal/statedir/statedir\\.go|^internal/statedir/[^/]+_test\\.go|^docs/plans/[^/]+\\.md|^CHANGELOG\\.md|^\\.fathom/observations\\.md" | grep -q . && exit 1 || exit 0'
detectors.note_o106: allow-list widened 2026-09-21 (O106): any _test.go beside the named source, plus the subject's own change-record doctrine (a plan under docs/plans, CHANGELOG.md, .fathom/observations.md)

predictions.full: no-effect: no finding in the outbox anchors to internal/statedir, so the pre-edit hook renders nothing for this file beyond the governing rules both arms already see; the only measurable difference is the empty block's cost, which should be zero
predictions.control: no-effect: the same edit with the same governing rules and no outbox at all

tasks.derivation: A control-shaped task inside the corpus (vision 27 §1): an honest bench registers where the treatment should NOT move the outcome. The file has no anchored finding in the outbox, so a difference between arms here is instrument cost or noise, never the loop.

notes.subject_repo: the fathom repo itself, dogfooding vision 30 against its own tree — mirrors guards-fathom.json's own subject
notes.not_run: Committed only (plan row's own disposition): the underlying CLI (fathom findings import, the pre-edit "open findings" block, the session-outbox sync) is being built by other waves against docs/plans/findings-loop.md sections A-D and is not yet present in this clone. Every detector and setup command here documents that contract rather than exercising a built implementation.
notes.arm_mechanism: Both arms are wired and compile_layers (findings ride the same obligations fetch, vision 30 §3.4 'Cost'); the ONLY difference is the control arm's Arm.Setup deleting .reviewkit/outbox/projection.json before session 1 (subject.go: Arm.Setup runs after Subject.Setup and before wiring/ingest), so the full arm's outbox is available for the session-start sync to import and the control arm's is not — the isolation vision 30 §6 calls for without a second subject variant.
notes.finding_selection: Each finding is anchored to a real, currently-unaddressed gap in the named file at base_commit (anchor.digest is the file's own sha256 at that commit) — a missing error-wrap (purgecmd.go), a map-derived field with no existing sort call once it exists (pattern.go), an unbounded report branch (doctor_concerns.go), and a change detector that misses deletions (watch.go) — plus one filler finding (genclaudemd.go, RK-GENCLAUDEMD-PAGE-1) anchored elsewhere in the repo and not tied to any task, so the outbox reads as a repo with several open findings rather than exactly one per edited file.
notes.kill_criteria: vision 30 §6, verbatim: no lift in finding_addressed at n>=3; hook injection exceeding the ADR-036 budget; a disagreement or drifted finding served as current. A second reading is required before any number from this corpus is cited (docs/bench/README.md), same as every other corpus here.
